Intermediate.learningGoal: Drive coroutines with resume and yield, producing generators and passing values both ways.
gotchas: resume returns true plus values or false plus error
Resuming a dead coroutine returns false with 'cannot resume dead coroutine'
yield passes values out and resume passes values in
shapeHints: a generator of game spawn waves
a scripted sequence that advances one step per update call

Advanced.learningGoal: Use coroutines for cooperative scheduling: sequencing over time and async-style APIs.
gotchas: Errors inside a coroutine do not propagate, resume returns false
yield across pcall is not allowed in Lua 5.1 (but is in LuaJIT)
A scheduler needs a time source and must not use real sleep
goodSolutionShows: A scheduler with an injected clock or dt that wakes coroutines
shapeHints: a cutscene/dialogue sequencer waiting N seconds (dt passed in) between steps
a Neovim-style async runner where a fake vim.schedule queues callbacks and the coroutine resumes in them

Expert.learningGoal: Build structured async helpers on coroutines: await, cancellation and combinators.
gotchas: Cancelling a coroutine that holds resources needs explicit cleanup
A callback that fires synchronously resumes the coroutine before it yielded
Combinators must collect results in order
goodSolutionShows: all() combinator preserving order, driven by a fake scheduler
shapeHints: an await helper wrapping callback-style fake vim.system or timers
a cancellable sleep sequence in a game timeline
